fullContent:
Ratnapurusha Lehyam 
 Introduction 
 Ratnapurusha Lehyam is probably one of the well-known Ayurvedic formulations that has potent use in improving vigour and strength. It is the best general and sexual tonic. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Twak ( Cinnamomum cassia ) 
 Chinoshana ( Cubeba officinalis) 
 Madanamastaki ( Cycas circinalis ) 
 Guduchi ( Tinospora cordifolia ) 
 Sariva ( Hemidesmus indicus ) 
 Vidari ( Ipomoea digitata ) 
 Nagakesara ( Mesua ferrea ) 
 Brihat Gokshura ( Pedalium murex ) 
 Maricha ( Piper nigrum ) 
 Marati mogga ( Kabab chini ) 
 Tavakshiri ( Bambusa arundinacea ) 
 Patra ( Cinnamomum iners ) 
 Talamuli kanda ( Curculigo orchioides ) 
 Ela ( Elettaria cardamomum ) 
 Madayantika ( Lawsonia inermis ) 
 Salep ( Orchis mascula ) 
 Pippali ( Piper longum ) 
 Ratnapurusha ( Viola suffruticosa ) 
 Ashwagandha ( Withania somnifera ) 
 
 Dosage 
 Consume 6-12g of this medicine 2 times daily along with a cup of milk with added sugar. 
 Therapeutic Uses 
 
 Ratnapurusha Lehyam has features to counter the nervous weakness 
 It can also improve erectile dysfunction and oligospermia. 
 It can also improves the erectile dysfunction and oligospermia. 
 Recovers vigor and strength. 
 Enhances semen volume. 
 
 Contraindications/ Side Effects 
 Till date no side effects have been notified. 
 However it must be consumed under strict medical directions. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
